versions.changelog:
- Initial release of huaweicloud-python-sdk-helper.
- Provides CLI tool to query installed Huawei Cloud Python SDK packages, Client classes, API methods, and input parameter details.
- Supports keyword search in method names and descriptions.
- Outputs structured (JSON) results for easy processing.
- Enables quick lookup of SDK class details: constructor arguments, attributes, types, and descriptions.
- Designed to help developers locate API usage methods without manual documentation lookup.
